title: XianzheFan/DreamAvoid
abstract:
DreamAvoid: Critical-Phase Test-Time Dreaming to Avoid Failures in VLA Policies

# DreamAvoid DreamAvoid is a critical-phase test-time dreaming framework for VLA (Vision-Language-Action) manipulation. The base policy is executed directly during routine steps, and test-time dreaming is invoked only when the system predicts an imminent transition into a critical phase. The system has three modules: a **Dream Trigger** that decides when to intervene, an **Action Proposer** that samples multiple candidate action chunks, and a **Dream Evaluator** that scores candidates by forward-simulating their short-horizon futures with an action-conditioned world model and a value model. ## Repository Layout ## Method to Code ### 1. Dream Trigger A lightweight network `f_phi(O_{t-K+1:t}, s_t) -> p_t` that takes the recent K-frame multi-view observations plus the proprioceptive state and outputs the probability that the system has entered a critical phase. Triggers when `p_t >= gamma`. | Component | File | |---|---| | Critical-phase annotation tool (`t_crit`) | `openpi-da/agilex/annotate_t_crit.py` | | Trainer (soft label `sigmoid((t - t_crit) / beta)`, class-balanced BCE with `w_+ = N_-/N_+`) | `openpi-da/agilex/train_dream_trigger.py` | | Online inference + threshold gating | `openpi-da/agilex/agilex_infer_dream_trigger.py` | ### 2. Action Proposer Replaces the deterministic ODE inference of the flow-matching base policy with the corresponding SDE `du = v_theta(u, rho | o_t, l) drho + sigma(rho) dW_rho`, generating multiple candidate action chunks per critical step. A constant noise schedule is used; per-task `sigma` values are configured at the policy level. | Component | File | |---|---| | SDE flow-matching model (config + sampler) | `openpi-da/src/openpi/models/pi0_sde.py` | | SDE policy server (multi-candidate sampling) | `openpi-da/scripts/serve_sde_policy.py` | | Combined policy server (base + SDE proposer) | `openpi-da/scripts/serve_combined_policy.py` | ### 3. abstract_zh: DreamAvoid是一个用于VLA（视觉-语言-动作）操作的关键阶段测试时梦境框架。在常规步骤中直接执行基础策略，仅当系统预测即将进入关键阶段时才调用测试时梦境。该系统包含三个模块：一个决定何时干预的梦境触发器，一个采样多个候选动作块的动作提议器，以及一个通过动作条件世界模型和价值模型对候选进行短视未来前向模拟评分的梦境评估器。
tldr_zh: 仅在预测到关键阶段时触发测试时梦境，避免VLA策略失败。
cover_zh: 别让机器人关键时刻掉链子｜这个框架只在危险时才“做梦”

judge.reason: 提出VLA策略的测试时梦境框架，含触发、提议、评估模块，创新性强且可落地。
